items.title: LinkedIn live account OAuth/publishing integration
items.owner_action: To go live: create a LinkedIn developer app, store the client id/secret + a member OAuth token/refresh token in Windows Credential Manager under the chief-linkedin-* targets (never in chat, GitHub or logs), then publish a reviewed draft with an explicit approval + confirm-token. Dry-run is the default and nothing posts without that owner approval.
